description: This file defines structures and functions for handling socket addresses, supporting both IPv4, IPv6, and Unix socket addresses, used internally in a network application.

methods.name: int sock_addr_get_family(const sock_addr * saddr)
methods.description: Returns the address family from a socket address.

methods.name: sock_addr_get_port
methods.description: Retrieves the port number from a socket address.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_addr_wildcard
methods.description: Checks if the socket address is an address wildcard (e.g., bind to all interfaces).

methods.name: sock_addr_is_family_eq
methods.description: Compares if two socket addresses have the same address family.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_port_eq
methods.description: Checks if two socket addresses have the same port.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_addr_eq
methods.description: Checks if two socket addresses are equal.

methods.name: sock_addr_is_addr_eq_bits
methods.description: Checks if two socket addresses are equal up to a certain number of bits.

methods.name: sock_addr_set_port
methods.description: Sets the port number in a socket address.

methods.name: sock_addr_assign
methods.description: Assigns a socket address with specified family, port, and address.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_pton
methods.description: Converts an IP address string to a socket address structure.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_ntop
methods.description: Converts a socket address to its string representation.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_ntop_copy_buffer
methods.description: Copies the string representation of a socket address into a buffer.

methods.name: sock_addr_inet_ntop_append_buffer
methods.description: Appends the string representation of a socket address to a buffer.

methods.name: sock_addr_stringify_append_buffer
methods.description: Serializes a socket address into a buffer.

methods.name: sock_addr_nameinfo_append_buffer
methods.description: Appends name information of a socket address to a buffer, with error handling.

methods.name: sock_addr_from_buffer_hints_numeric
methods.description: Constructs a socket address from buffer hints and numeric address.

methods.name: sock_addr_from_str_hints
methods.description: Creates a socket address from a string with hints.

methods.name: sock_addr_from_str_numeric
methods.description: Creates a socket address from a numeric string.
